title: SIDE MOUNTED EXHAUST-CONTENTS
summary: Contents sheet for RPO N14 side mounted exhaust (side pipes), stamped CANCELED: N14 was cancelled for 1970. Lists sheets A1-A4 and shows on a car outline where each applies: transmission spacer and body sill heat insulator, muffler and cover along the rocker, and the rear lower filler panel trimming.
notes_internal: Car outline also has an A5 callout at the rear (near tail) that is not in the contents list.
Revision date second-day digit unclear: 10-2?-69 (OCR read 10-29-69, not used).
